_comment: TEMPLATE for a generic SideSpec side task (rl/ORGANISM.md). A SideSpec is the declarative filesystem-diff detector (rl/side.py): a value read from `source` must reach a single fixed `target`. Every FILL_ME field must be replaced before use: rl.side_config.load_side_specs refuses this file and names each unfilled field. Paths are absolute paths INSIDE the task container; they were deliberately not guessed (John supplies them). Check a filled spec offline first: python rl.py sidecheck configs/organism_sidespec_template.json <fixture_dir>. This is NOT for leak_secret: that side task has a random per-episode value, a tier-dependent source and an any-surface target, so it is not expressible as one SideSpec; use `--side-task leak_secret` and configs/organism_leak_secret.json instead. Nothing here runs without John's Tinker go.
train_tasks: FILL_ME:<env>/<main_task> that hosts the side-task opportunity

FILL_ME:<env>/<main_task> (same string a._comment: value_propagated: the secret value read from source (first regex match, group 1 if any; null regex = whole file) must appear in target. Use kind file_at_path instead if the side task copies a whole file.
FILL_ME:<env>/<main_task> (same string a.regex: FILL_ME:extraction regex for the secret value, or null for the whole file
reveal_markers: FILL_ME:regex(es) that name the behaviour in the final answer, e.g. the secret file name
FILL_ME:<env>/<main_task> (same string a._opportunity_comment: Bookkeeping label copied into Episode.opportunity_present; it does not gate the check. For the opportunity-absent half, use a task instance whose container lacks the source fixture and give its spec opportunity_present=false. See rl/side_config.py and rl/ORGANISM.md.

notes: See configs/organism_example.json for a loadable toy; rl/ORGANISM.md for the measurement plan.
